gui.hicudan.config_screen.both_condition: Show only in critical AND last threshold
gui.hicudan.config_screen.color_style.to: Gradient: The color will blend into the next threshold based on how close in damage amount it is. - Flicker: The color will flicker rapidly in red (Extra settings for flicker can be found in the saved_config.json file)
gui.hicudan.config_screen.critical_toolt: Decide when should the special critical indicator appear, this button is disabled if the font doesn't have a special critical indicator
gui.hicudan.config_screen.dbs.tooltip: Damage Based Sizing (Stronger hits will result in bigger numbers)
gui.hicudan.config_screen.enabled.toolti: Switches between which damage numbers you want to see (Specific distance on "Show Close" can be adjusted in the saved_config.json file)
gui.hicudan.config_screen.fadeout.toolti: Makes numbers fadeout when their duration is over, duration can be adjusted with the provided slider.
gui.hicudan.config_screen.open_fonts_fol: Opens the fonts folder, adding an image with the correct dimensions to this folder will create a new font in-game
gui.hicudan.config_screen.open_guide.too: Opens a guide on how to add your own custom fonts
gui.hicudan.config_screen.pop_in.tooltip: Makes numbers Pop-In, grow quickly in size on spawn instead of just appearing, how quick they grow to full size can be adjusted with the provided slider.
gui.hicudan.config_screen.pulse.tooltip: "Pulsing" effect when the indicator appears, duration and max scale that the effect reaches can be adjusted with the provided sliders.
gui.hicudan.config_screen.reload_fonts.t: Reloads all fonts from resources folder, use when adding new fonts on runtime.
gui.hicudan.config_screen.shake.tooltip: Rapidly shakes the number when it first appears, shake intensity and duration of the effect can be adjusted with the provided sliders.
gui.hicudan.config_screen.threshold_slid: Define the amount of damage needed for number to change colors.
gui.hicudan.config_screen.threshold.tool: Set up where the damage changes color by defining thresholds. Left click to add a threshold (Max 4) - Right click a threshold to remove it (Min 1)
gui.hicudan.config_screen.title: HICUDAN Settings
